checks.evidence: Action: Observe the scene, seek 0, 12, 24, 48, 30, 17, 73, 120, then repeat noncanonical times; select each rendered planet at its predicted projected position. Expected: One sun, exactly three distinct planets, circular motion with fixed phases and periods 12/24/48. Observed: Cyan small Mercury, amber medium Venus and blue larger Earth orbit one gold sun. Every predicted-position canvas click selected the intended planet. At t=0 angles were 12/126/248 degrees; at 12, 12/306/338; at 24, 12/126/68; at 48, 12/126/248. Readouts, rendered motion and fixed-radius orbit paths agreed with phase+360t/period.

Action: Open fresh HTTP viewport and reload after editing live state and saving snapshots. Expected: Time starts from zero, 1x, playing, no selection, overview. Observed: A same-call post-reload snapshot at 0.1 seconds showed LIVE, 1.00x, no selected planet, explicit no-selection information, disabled tracking and FULL SYSTEM. Subsequent time and three planet positions advanced automatically. The elapsed 0.1 seconds is load time, not a reset defect; saved snapshots did not restore live state.

Action: Pause, seek and wait at 17 seconds at each speed; use selection and camera while paused; resume. Expected: Time/positions freeze, controls remain usable, resume continues without a jump. Observed: Each 3.1-second paused wait retained 17.0. Paused planet angles and repeated scene positions remained fixed; canvas selection and orbit/zoom operated. Resumed samples advanced continuously from 17.0, and the original 30-second scenario continued smoothly at 2x.

Action: Set 0.25x, 2x, 4x paused and playing, then measure uninterrupted foreground intervals away from 120. Expected: No seek or position reset; all rates scale together. Observed: Paused time stayed 17.0 before/after each 3.1-second wait. Visible 1440x900 samples were 0.25x: 3.202 wall seconds, 17.0 to17.8; 2x:3.203, 17.4 to23.8; 4x:3.204, 17.8 to30.6. All satisfy preregistered tolerance. Playing changes to 4x, 0.25x and2x preserved ongoing time and selection. Period/phase readouts and scene positions remained derived from the same time, with no resume jump.
